name: AI SDK UI
summary: AI SDK UI is the frontend half of Vercel's open-source AI SDK. Hooks such as useChat, useCompletion and useObject stream chat messages, completions and structured JSON from a server route and manage message, loading and error state, leaving the visual design to the app.
facts: React, Vue, Svelte, Angular (SolidJS via community)
goodFor: Custom chat UIs in Next.js or React apps
Streaming text and structured objects to the browser
Teams that want hooks, not prebuilt components
watchOut: No visual components; you build the interface
Frequent major versions with migration work
